summary: Frontend-only re-test of /grid bug fixes. All three fixes verified via live DOM boundingBox and inner_text assertions: (1) Text auto-fits — 0/25 overflow cases across initial + 4 restructures + long single word; (2) Fluid resize animation — cells have inline transition with cubic-bezier(0.45,0.05,0.15,1) on width/height/left/top and 6/7 cells changed dimensions on Space cut and on Play; (3) Editable IDX — grid-idx-input present, setting '949' immediately shows 'IDX-949' in metadata, persists across 4 restructures, and clearing reverts to auto IDX-### values that change on restructure. Regression: palette (red), invert, flip toggles, title/subtitle inputs update meta block, mode-kinetic link href='/'.
critical_code_review_comments: GridStage.jsx textWidthAt1px measures with a fallback font stack ('Archivo Black' etc.); if the web font hasn't loaded yet on first render, the measurement may be off. In this run it worked fine, but consider re-measuring on document.fonts.ready to be safe.
The auto-fit uses whiteSpace: 'nowrap' with a single-line span; very tall narrow cells rotate the text (vertical mode) which is handled — verified for the rotated cases too.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 grid fixes verified. Text auto-fit: measure span bbox vs cell wrapper bbox (allow +3px tolerance) across multiple restructures. Fluid resize: capture bboxes before/after Space press with 700ms settle; expect >0 cells with changed w/h; inline style must contain cubic-bezier. IDX: grid-idx-input controls override — non-empty value produces 'IDX-<value>' persistent across restructures; empty reverts to auto scene.idxCode which changes per cutSeed.
